## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally: `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] New or changed behaviour is covered by tests
- [ ] Docs in `docs/` or the README are updated where behaviour or the operator interface changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, tests or output
- [ ] If this touches deploy, supervisor or verification code (trust-critical): failure and rollback paths are tested

See CONTRIBUTING.md in the repository root.
